key_trends: AI and automation driving efficiency, risk management, and customer experience in financial services
Embedded finance expanding distribution through partnerships and non-traditional platforms (BaaS, open APIs)
Tokenization and digital currencies enabling faster, cheaper cross-border payments and settlement
Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) and digital payments shaping the payments landscape
Continued M&A activity and deal flow in financial services, with focus on scale and capabilities
Adoption of AI across compliance, fraud detection, underwriting, and operational efficiency
reasoning: As of September 6, 2025, multiple leading firms and financial institutions report that the finance industry is undergoing a technology-driven transformation. AI and automation are expected to unlock significant productivity and cost savings, while embedded finance and BaaS are expanding revenue and distribution channels beyond traditional banks. Tokenization and digital currencies are improving cross-border settlement and payment efficiency, and CBDCs are influencing ongoing payments modernization. Although profitability remains heterogeneous—often pressured in lower-rate environments—the net effect of these trends is a positive outlook due to increased efficiency, new revenue streams, and more agile operating models. These themes are reflected in Deloitte's 2025 financial services predictions, EY and PwC insights on embedded finance and deal activity, and Morgan Stanley's coverage of AI-driven banking trends, among others.
